title: Agent runs
description: Runs across every workspace: outcomes, failures, cost and bots, and one run in detail. Read from the obs model (ADR-0046); the ledger is never read here.

list.name: run
list.label: Run id
list.description: A run id for the One run section; the run drawer's Analytics link sets it.

list.name: min_similarity
list.label: Min similarity
list.description: Failure retrospective: hide matches below this cosine similarity. A display filter only; every match is stored.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Runs created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs created in the time range that ended failed.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS failed FROM run_metrics WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS failed FROM run_metrics WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Failure rate
panels.description: Failed runs as a share of finished runs created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS failure_rate FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS failure_rate FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Median run time
panels.description: Median duration of finished runs created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT median AS median_duration_ms FROM (SELECT avg(duration_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m
targets.queryText: SELECT median AS median_duration_ms FROM (SELECT avg(duration_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT duration_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT duration_ms FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Priced usage of runs created in the time range; unpriced models count 0.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Marked wrong
panels.description: Runs a person marked wrong in the run drawer (ADR-0042).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT coalesce(sum(marked_wrong), 0) AS marked_wrong FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT coalesce(sum(marked_wrong), 0) AS marked_wrong FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Runs per hour by status
panels.description: Runs created per hour, stacked by their latest status.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', created_at) AS time, status, count(*) AS runs FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', created_at) AS time, status, count(*) AS runs FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Cost per hour by model
panels.description: Priced usage per hour of runs created then, by the run's model.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', created_at) AS time, coalesce(model, 'unknown') AS model, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', created_at) AS time, coalesce(model, 'unknown') AS model, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Failures by class and model
panels.description: Failed runs grouped by failure class (ADR-0042), model, run type and trigger. A model the upstream does not serve shows here first.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT coalesce(failure_class, 'unclassified') AS failure_class, coalesce(model, '') AS model, run_type, trigger_kind, count(*) AS runs, max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM run_metrics WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY runs DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT coalesce(failure_class, 'unclassified') AS failure_class, coalesce(model, '') AS model, run_type, trigger_kind, count(*) AS runs, max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM run_metrics WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY runs DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Refused model requests
panels.description: Model requests the proxy refused, by requested and served model and the refusal.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT model, coalesce(served_model, '') AS served_model, refusal, count(*) AS requests, count(DISTINCT run_id) AS runs, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM requests_named WHERE refusal IS NOT NULL AND ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY requests DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT model, coalesce(served_model, '') AS served_model, refusal, count(*) AS requests, count(DISTINCT run_id) AS runs, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM requests_named WHERE refusal IS NOT NULL AND ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY requests DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Bots
panels.description: Per bot: runs, failures, marks, median run time, tool errors and cost, for runs created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT b.workspace_name, b.bot_name, b.runs, b.failed, b.marked_wrong, m.median AS median_duration_ms, b.tool_errors, b.cost_usd FROM (SELECT bot_id, max(workspace_name) AS workspace_name, max(bot_name) AS bot_name, count(*) AS runs, sum(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, sum(marked_wrong) AS marked_wrong, sum(tool_errors) AS tool_errors, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY bot_id) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_id, avg(duration_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT bot_id, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bot_id ORDER BY duration_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bot_id) AS median_n FROM (SELECT bot_id, duration_ms FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY bot_id) m ON m.bot_id = b.bot_id ORDER BY b.runs DESC, b.bot_name LIMIT 200
targets.queryText: SELECT b.workspace_name, b.bot_name, b.runs, b.failed, b.marked_wrong, m.median AS median_duration_ms, b.tool_errors, b.cost_usd FROM (SELECT bot_id, max(workspace_name) AS workspace_name, max(bot_name) AS bot_name, count(*) AS runs, sum(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, sum(marked_wrong) AS marked_wrong, sum(tool_errors) AS tool_errors, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM run_metrics WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY bot_id) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_id, avg(duration_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT bot_id, duration_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bot_id ORDER BY duration_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bot_id) AS median_n FROM (SELECT bot_id, duration_ms FROM run_metrics WHERE terminal = 1 AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY bot_id) m ON m.bot_id = b.bot_id ORDER BY b.runs DESC, b.bot_name LIMIT 200

panels.title: Runs to look at
panels.description: The newest runs that failed, stayed silent, were cancelled or stopped, or were marked wrong. A run id opens it in One run below.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT created_at, workspace_name, bot_name, trigger_kind, run_type, model, status, failure_class, marked_wrong, tool_errors, refused_requests, duration_ms, cost_usd, run_id FROM run_metrics WHERE (status IN ('failed', 'silent', 'cancelled', 'stopped') OR marked_wrong = 1) AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.queryText: SELECT created_at, workspace_name, bot_name, trigger_kind, run_type, model, status, failure_class, marked_wrong, tool_errors, refused_requests, duration_ms, cost_usd, run_id FROM run_metrics WHERE (status IN ('failed', 'silent', 'cancelled', 'stopped') OR marked_wrong = 1) AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Run
panels.description: The run's latest state, totals, error, mark and Activity summary.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.run_id, m.workspace_name, m.bot_name, m.trigger_kind, m.run_type, m.lane, m.status, m.failure_class, m.model, m.created_at, m.finished_at, m.queue_ms, m.duration_ms, m.tool_calls, m.tool_errors, m.model_requests, m.refused_requests, m.approvals, m.approval_wait_ms, m.cost_usd, n.error, n.mark_note, n.summary FROM run_metrics m LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = m.run_id WHERE m.run_id = ${run:sqlstring}
targets.queryText: SELECT m.run_id, m.workspace_name, m.bot_name, m.trigger_kind, m.run_type, m.lane, m.status, m.failure_class, m.model, m.created_at, m.finished_at, m.queue_ms, m.duration_ms, m.tool_calls, m.tool_errors, m.model_requests, m.refused_requests, m.approvals, m.approval_wait_ms, m.cost_usd, n.error, n.mark_note, n.summary FROM run_metrics m LEFT JOIN runs_named n ON n.run_id = m.run_id WHERE m.run_id = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: The run's tool calls in order, with their outcome and time.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT called_at, tool_name, risk_level, outcome, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY called_at, tool_use_id
targets.queryText: SELECT called_at, tool_name, risk_level, outcome, duration_ms FROM tool_calls WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY called_at, tool_use_id

panels.title: Phases
panels.description: The run's completed phase-timing spans in the order they ended.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ended_at, phase, tool_name, request_kind, outcome, duration_ms FROM phase_spans WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY ended_at, span_id
targets.queryText: SELECT ended_at, phase, tool_name, request_kind, outcome, duration_ms FROM phase_spans WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY ended_at, span_id

panels.title: Model requests
panels.description: The run's model requests with their shape and token counts.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts, request_kind, model, served_model, refusal, prompt_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, messages_count, tools_count FROM requests_named WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY ts, request_id
targets.queryText: SELECT ts, request_kind, model, served_model, refusal, prompt_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, messages_count, tools_count FROM requests_named WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY ts, request_id

panels.title: Nearest successful runs
panels.description: When this run failed: the succeeded runs of its workspace whose Activity summary is closest to its own (failure retrospective).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT rank, similarity, match_bot_name, match_created_at, match_summary, match_run_id FROM failure_matches WHERE failed_run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) ORDER BY rank
targets.queryText: SELECT rank, similarity, match_bot_name, match_created_at, match_summary, match_run_id FROM failure_matches WHERE failed_run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) ORDER BY rank

panels.title: Approvals
panels.description: The run's decided approvals and how long each waited.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT created_at, kind, tool_name, risk_level, decision, decided_by, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY created_at, approval_id
targets.queryText: SELECT created_at, kind, tool_name, risk_level, decision, decided_by, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY created_at, approval_id

panels.title: Failed runs with matches
panels.description: Failed runs created in the time range that have at least one nearest successful run at or above the minimum similarity.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT failed_run_id) AS failed_runs FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT failed_run_id) AS failed_runs FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Median best similarity
panels.description: The median similarity of each failed run's closest match, over failed runs created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT median AS median_similarity FROM (SELECT avg(similarity) AS median FROM (SELECT similarity, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY similarity) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT similarity FROM failure_matches WHERE rank = 1 AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE similarity IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m
targets.queryText: SELECT median AS median_similarity FROM (SELECT avg(similarity) AS median FROM (SELECT similarity, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY similarity) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT similarity FROM failure_matches WHERE rank = 1 AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE similarity IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m

panels.title: Matches by failure class
panels.description: Per failure class: failed runs with matches and the median similarity of their closest match.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT c.failure_class, c.failed_runs, m.median AS median_best_similarity FROM (SELECT failure_class, count(DISTINCT failed_run_id) AS failed_runs FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY failure_class) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT failure_class, avg(similarity) AS median FROM (SELECT failure_class, similarity, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY failure_class ORDER BY similarity) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY failure_class) AS median_n FROM (SELECT failure_class, similarity FROM failure_matches WHERE rank = 1 AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE similarity IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY failure_class) m ON m.failure_class = c.failure_class ORDER BY c.failed_runs DESC, c.failure_class
targets.queryText: SELECT c.failure_class, c.failed_runs, m.median AS median_best_similarity FROM (SELECT failure_class, count(DISTINCT failed_run_id) AS failed_runs FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY failure_class) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT failure_class, avg(similarity) AS median FROM (SELECT failure_class, similarity, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY failure_class ORDER BY similarity) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY failure_class) AS median_n FROM (SELECT failure_class, similarity FROM failure_matches WHERE rank = 1 AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE similarity IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY failure_class) m ON m.failure_class = c.failure_class ORDER BY c.failed_runs DESC, c.failure_class

panels.title: Failure retrospective
panels.description: Each failed run with its nearest succeeded runs of the same workspace by Activity summary, most similar first. No private chat's run appears, and a run marked wrong is never offered. Either run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT failed_at, workspace_name, bot_name, failure_class, coalesce(failed_summary, failed_error) AS failed_text, failed_run_id, rank, similarity, match_bot_name, match_created_at, match_summary, match_run_id FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at IS NOT NULL AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY failed_at DESC, failed_run_id, rank LIMIT 200
targets.queryText: SELECT failed_at, workspace_name, bot_name, failure_class, coalesce(failed_summary, failed_error) AS failed_text, failed_run_id, rank, similarity, match_bot_name, match_created_at, match_summary, match_run_id FROM failure_matches WHERE similarity >= coalesce(CAST(nullif(${min_similarity:sqlstring}, '') AS REAL), 0) AND failed_at IS NOT NULL AND failed_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND failed_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY failed_at DESC, failed_run_id, rank LIMIT 200

panels.title: Ingest watermarks
panels.description: Per obs table: batches and rows committed, the newest batch, and how long ago it was committed. A growing lag means the collector is behind.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT table_name, batches, rows, last_batch_id, last_closed_at, last_committed_at, ((julianday('now') - julianday(last_committed_at)) * 86400000.0) AS lag_ms FROM watermarks ORDER BY table_name
targets.queryText: SELECT table_name, batches, rows, last_batch_id, last_closed_at, last_committed_at, ((julianday('now') - julianday(last_committed_at)) * 86400000.0) AS lag_ms FROM watermarks ORDER BY table_name
